game.name: Just Cause 2 (Japan)
game.desc: The character of Rico Rodriguez is back in Just Cause 2 on Xbox 360, a fast-paced action game set in the Asian islands of Panau and offering 1,000 square kilometres to explore in a variety of vehicles. A wide range of weapons are available to carry out your missions, which you can complete with stunts. Use the parachute and grappling hook to get out of dangerous situations, ensuring your survival in hostile environments.
game.genre: Shooter / TPV, Shooter, Action / Adventure, Action
